description: This file defines localization (culture-specific) settings and date manipulation utilities for the 'en-PH' culture (English - Philippines) in the Datejs library. It includes day and month names, date formats, regex patterns for parsing date components, and prototype extensions for date calculations and formatting.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a Date object to zero (midnight).

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the Date object with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Retrieves the index of a day based on its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Retrieves the index of a month based on its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specified month of a year.
